transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—thanks for coming today. To start off, can you tell me what's been bringing you in to see me?

I came in because I keep hearing Garrett’s voice. It’s as clear as if he’s standing right behind me—on the trail or when I’m in my painting room. Part of me knows he’s dead, but when it happens, it feels completely real.
How long after Garrett passed away did you first start hearing his voice?
It started during that wired stretch, when I was barely sleeping and felt driven to keep taking on more and more. I hadn’t heard his voice before that—nothing like this during regular grief.
During that period when you felt wired and were taking on more than usual, about how many days in a row did that heightened energy and reduced need for sleep last?
It’s been about a month altogether since Garrett died. The wired, barely-sleeping period was part of this whole month-long crisis.
During that month when you felt wired and needed less sleep, did you also notice your mood becoming unusually elevated, euphoric, or irritable—different from your normal grief?
Yeah. At first I felt almost lit up, like I had this urgent purpose that nobody else could understand. But if anyone questioned me or tried to slow me down, I’d get furious—snap at them.

Before Garrett passed away, had you ever experienced a period—lasting several days or more—where you felt unusually energetic, elevated, or irritable, or conversely, deeply depressed, even before this recent crisis?
I’m not sure. I can’t really think of a time before all this where it was that clear or lasted for days.
Thinking specifically about that lit-up, high-energy, irritable stretch you described—how many days in a row did that particular mood and energy state continue before it started to change?
It’s been going on through this whole crisis—about a month now, since Garrett died.
Does hearing Garrett's voice happen only when you're feeling that wired, keyed-up, or irritable, or does it also occur when your mood feels more calm or back to normal?
No, only during that wired period. It started when I was barely sleeping and felt driven to keep going. I’d never heard Garrett’s voice before that—not just during normal grief.
During that lit-up, high-energy period, did you feel unusually confident or believe you had special abilities, insights, or a mission that others couldn't understand?
I’m not sure. I felt very keyed up, but I can’t say I thought I had some special ability or mission that other people didn’t understand.
During that lit-up, wired period, did you notice your thoughts racing or jumping quickly from one idea to another, faster than usual?

Yes. My thoughts go so fast I can’t hold onto one thing. I’ll be thinking about a patient note, and suddenly it’s five different projects, then a hike I took, then guilt about the funeral—all before I can catch up.
